verdict.rationale: Rippling IT documents federated identity across SAML, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP and RADIUS apps, which implies single sign-on, and automatic role-based provisioning, which implies employees get the apps they're assigned. Nothing in the evidence describes an employee-facing launcher dashboard or a browser extension. Missing for 10: an evidenced employee app-launcher portal, a browser extension for sign-in or password fill, an explicit sign-in-once SSO description, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
